title: Crestline Fleet Account Invoiced Volume Points
content:
The early-pay discount of a Crestline Fleet Account recognises the volume of work the business charges to the account. Invoiced volume points are added to the early-pay rate, the percent at which the early-pay discount is figured on an invoice that earns it.

| Total of invoices posted to the account less than twelve whole months before today (USD) | Invoiced volume points |
|---|---|
| 40000.00 or more | 0.25 |
| 20000.00 to 39999.99 | 0.10 |
| less than 20000.00 | none |

The total is the sum of the invoice amounts of every fleet invoice posted to the account with an invoice date less than twelve whole months before today.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical totals)

| Twelve-month invoice total | Points |
|---|---|
| 19999.99 | none |
| 20000.00 | 0.10 |
| 39999.99 | 0.10 |
| 40000.00 | 0.25 |

The points are percentage points of the early-pay rate. On a program whose early-pay discount percent is 0, the invoice earns no discount, whatever is added to the early-pay rate.
